therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: radioligand binding to amyloid plaques enabling PET imaging
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: in vivo detection and quantification of cerebral amyloid burden
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with suspected Alzheimer's disease undergoing end-of-life care (autopsy cohort) and younger healthy controls (specificity cohort)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Spearman's rank order correlation of florbetapir-PET image and amyloid plaque density at autopsy; specificity in younger healthy controls

results.effect_size: Spearman's correlation coefficient = 0.78 (95% CI: 0.58–0.89); Specificity = 100% (95% CI: 91–100)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Spearman's rank correlation of 0.78 between PET visual read and post-mortem IHC amyloid plaque density across 6 brain regions
biomarker_changes: Median semi-quantitative visual read of florbetapir-PET correlated with quantitative IHC amyloid plaque density (r=0.78, p<0.0001)
Regional correlations ranged from 0.68 (temporal cortex) to 0.77 (parietal cortex)
100% specificity in younger healthy controls presumed amyloid-negative (47/47 negative scans)
safety_signals: 1 case of respiratory failure (serious adverse event) in the autopsy cohort (1/152)

dose_info.schedule: single i.v. bolus injection 50 minutes prior to imaging

context.duration: up to 12 months post-scan (autopsy cohort); 50-60 minutes post-injection (specificity cohort)
